title: Green Account (savings): Pairing with EcoCard for bonus APY
summary: Explains how Rho-Bank Green Account (savings) bonus APY works: 4.0% base, plus an additional 0.5% when you hold an eligible EcoCard linked to the account (effective APY 4.5% while eligibility is maintained). It also covers an extra 2.0% cashback at eco-certified merchants using an EcoCard, and lists APY bonus percentages from other Rho-Bank credit cards on the Green Account (savings). Eligibility requires the linked card remain in good standing; closing/unlinking removes the 0.5% and 2.0% bonuses.
